text:
Maria (runtime): quick heads-up — we want to open a wave gate for the router/runtime/console trio in the 02:00–04:00 UTC window tomorrow. low-risk canary first, full wave after green.
Dan (api): ack. which pins are we applying? need to avoid mixing router pinned hash with an unrolled runtime variant.
Maria (runtime): plan is: runtime:v2.14.1 (quant-rt patch), router:route-hash-2026-03-15 (no behavioural change), console:ui-3.2.0. runtime will expose compat flag `serve_compat_v2` for 1 hour.
Joyce (console): release notes ready. will toggle console feature flag only after canary passes. will not ship UI migrations until runtime confirms KV eviction preset.
Samir (router): eviction sanity check: the new router code prunes stale cache keys more aggressively. need to confirm runtime KV TTL still matches router expectations (>= 30s for live sessions).
Maria (runtime): confirmed: KV TTL default 45s in v2.14.1. patch includes explicit TTL guard. also added a quick telemetry spike counter for evictions.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled by @Maria for 2026-03-22T02:15Z: services=[runtime,router,console], strategy=staggered-canary(5%->25%->100%), rollback-window=15m.
Dan (api): will pin API schema to v1.8.0 for the window. api team will not accept traffic beyond the canary if schema mismatch detected.
Samir (router): small ask — can router backoff to fallback-route if runtime responds 504 thrice? current setting is 2. suggest 3 to reduce flapping.
Maria (runtime): ok to 3. I'll push a runtime flag `router_fail_threshold=3`.
Joyce (console): checklist before shifting to 25%: release notes deployed, dashboard alert rule `console-err-rate` set to p90 2x baseline, user-visible changelog updated.
Infra Oncall: ops checklist: LP metrics, token-cost spike alert, and redis eviction rate monitor must be green. I'll keep a pager on during the canary.
Dan (api): tests to run: contract smoke, auth header passthrough, and streaming handshake. I can run after canary 5% completes.
Maria (runtime): quick command for folks to verify pinned router hash in staging: `curl -sS https://router-staging.internal/meta | jq '.pin_hash'` — expect "route-hash-2026-03-15".
Samir (router): also run `kubectl get ep router -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.labels.version}'` to ensure nodes picked correct image.
Joyce (console): if we need to rollback: steps are 1) pin router back to previous hash 2) runtime rollback to v2.14.0 via deploybot 3) console feature flag off. Keep rollout notes clear.
Maria (runtime): deploybot rollback command for quick manual rollback: ``deploy-bot rollback --service runtime --to v2.14.0 --reason "eviction-regression"``. we tested this flow in staging.
DeployBot: NOTE: automated health checks will trigger rollback after 3 consecutive failing canary intervals or manual `:rollback` reaction.
Samir (router): small config lint: `router.pinning.mode` must be `strict` during the window to avoid mixed routes. please confirm before launching.
Dan (api): confirmed strict pinning OK from API.
Joyce (console): tagging release notes with `#safewave` and adding a short rollback stanza for SRE to read in-console.
Infra Oncall: I'll keep the quiet window slack channel open. Ping me with `@Infra Oncall` if thresholds trip.
Maria (runtime): final go/no-go times: 01:45 UTC preflight; 02:15 start canary; 02:35 evaluate metrics; 03:00 ramp to 25%; 03:30 evaluate; 03:45 ramp to 100%. if anything odd, we hold and rollback.
Dan (api): I'll post the contract smoke results under this thread after 02:40.
Joyce (console): I'll flip the console flag only after 02:40 green.
Samir (router): router will log a trace tag `wave_gate=4391023456` for all canary traffic so we can filter.
Maria (runtime): thanks all — posting preflight ops checklist in the release doc and will ping again at 01:40 UTC. :thumbsup:
Infra Oncall: :thumbsup: will be watching and ready to escalate.
DeployBot: Deploy started 2026-03-22T02:15Z for canary group 5%.
